title: Quintessential Smoky Mediterranean Eggplant Skillet
description: A cozy, crispy dish of eggplant infused with smoky paprika and brightened by apple cider vinegar and lemon, finished with chickpeas and feta for a flexitarian twist.
instructions: Heat a large skillet over medium heat and add 1 tablespoon of olive oil to warm.
Add the diced eggplant to the skillet and sauté until it begins to brown, about 5 minutes.
Stir in the minced garlic, black pepper, and sea salt, cooking until fragrant, about 1 minute.
Sprinkle the smoked paprika over the vegetables and toss to coat evenly.
Add the halved cherry tomatoes and continue cooking until the tomatoes soften, about 3 minutes.
Pour in the apple cider vinegar and lemon juice, stirring to combine and deglaze the pan.
Fold in the cooked chickpeas and crumbled feta cheese, allowing the mixture to simmer for 4 minutes.
Reduce the heat to low, cover the skillet, and let the flavors meld for 6 minutes, stirring occasionally.
Once the eggplant is tender and the sauce has thickened slightly, remove the skillet from heat.
Sprinkle the chopped fresh parsley over the top and serve hot, optionally with crusty bread for scooping.
